title: Final 18 — Jedynka i zapłon K20
description: K20 zatrzymuje się na jedynce, przez moment pozostaje martwa, a następnie uruchamia się mimo pozornie fatalnego wyniku.

prompts.image: Photorealistic live-action 16:9 extreme locked 100 mm macro at concrete level, continuous with Halinka's release. The tiny canonical 3 cm regular icosahedral K20 is tilted on one edge near center-right, just finishing its roll. Exactly one numeral is readable: a single gold 1 on the triangular face rotating upward. Every other face is turned away, in deep shadow or outside razor-thin focus; face 20 is hidden on the underside. The die is inert dark emerald with aged-gold edges and no internal glow. A faint dust wisp trails the rolling edge; distant shoes remain soft. No hand, cookie, levitation, giant die, second readable numeral, visible 20, magic, UI, captions or watermark.
prompts.animation: One continuous 3-second macro. The K20 stops with 1 clearly up and remains completely dark for one tense beat. Then a deep green and old-gold light ignites inside it and spreads through the engraved edges. The die stays still after stopping. No explosion or camera cut.
